spans.text: For the sake of continuity, please read this excerpt after you have completed "Sweet Dreams Box - Beginning".
André the security guard reported a sighting of intruders last night. Ange has sent AN-94 to the security room to investigate.
AN-94 arrives at the security room just as André is seeing Hopps off.
Mr. André, Miss Angelia sent me. Apparently you have clues pertaining to the intruders?
Frau...Antje, right?
Yes, that is my name.
I did discover something unusual, but most of it has been washed away by the rain.
It's probably nothing, to be honest.
It doesn't matter. Let's take a look at the scene.
Say, shouldn't we leave this kind of stuff to the police?
I know you are the representatives' bodyguards, but is it really necessary for you to get involved?
Miss Morridow has contacted the police, but their arrival is being delayed by the storm, that's why we would like to conduct a preliminary investigation ourselves.
Uh...
Fine. But don't say I didn't warn you, young lady.
Refugees have been banding together to rob properties in this area for quite a while now. The housemother most probably also died at their hands.
I hate the idea of going beyond the fence in the middle of the night.
Don't worry, just take me to the general location.
Alright... You're not giving me much choice.
Come along then.

André leads AN-94 north. She didn't notice before, but mountains form a natural barrier that spans across the northern side of the orphanage. The surrounding fence is only built on the other three sides.
So there are mountains behind Berle Orphanage. I didn't notice that on the way here.
Those mountains are a serious security issue for us. We've discovered that refugees use them as shelters. We've even found bedding and over two weeks' worth of food scraps in there...
If there are hideouts in the mountains, then it is a lot more likely that the intruder broke into the housemother's office from the outside...
Did the housemother not take any measures to tighten security in the north?
That costs money.
I'm still owed several months' worth of my salary.
But I didn't make a fuss for the sake of the kids.
It was very kind of the housemother to provide for orphans who came from the contamination zones.
It's always the poor who try to save others while the rich only think about their own comfort.
I see...
The housemother was really down on her luck. Those refugees must've had their eyes on her for some time.
I doubt I can stay here much longer myself. I'd better look for another job at a safer place.
You've done your best.
Right, we're here.
Dammit, the rain has washed everything away. There were a few footprints here before.
I understand. Just leave the rest to me and return to the orphanage.
Huh?
You're heading into the mountains?
That's way too dangerous.
It's alright. For your safety, please return to the hall and wait for me.
I will return, I promise.
Well... Good luck then.
Erwin, do you copy?
Loud and clear. What's the situation?
The security guard led me to the location where he had previously discovered evidence left behind by a possible intruder. The soil has definitely been disturbed here.
I suspect it bears footprints that were erased by the rain. I'm about to follow them.
Do you require backup?
Keep up your own investigation. I'll get in touch if I need help.
Understood. Be careful.
AN-94 follows the trail into the mountains.
She finally finds what she's after deep inside.
She pushes a patch of shrubbery aside and reveals a round black manhole cover made of metal with a ring pull attached.
The ring pull feels a little greasy. Somebody must have used it recently.
A manhole cover? Why would there be a manhole cover in such a place? Ange, are you seeing this?
Yes. Look around and show me your surroundings.
The grass here looks like it's been stepped on.
The ring pull has also been used.
There shouldn't be a manhole in the mountains. Open the cover and see what's down there.
Roger.
AN-94 lifts the metal cover with a single hand. A pungent odor of decay wafts through the opening. The hole looks pitch dark and bottomless.
It's big, a meter in diameter.
Shine your flashlight in there.
Okay.
Hm?!
All of a sudden, someone clamps a hand over AN-94's mouth and slashes her throat with a blade.
AN-94 loses her balance and tumbles into the dark manhole, then the manhole cover is put back in place and sealed tight.
AN-94 finds her bearing at the bottom of the pit. Her automatic self-diagnostics indicate that she has only suffered minor damage.
What just happened, Antje?!
Are you alright?!
I'm...fine...
I was attacked...
I didn't sense anyone behind me at all...
Glad to hear you're okay. Damage report.
My assailant tried to slash my throat, but the cut wasn't deep and didn't damage any important components. I will close the wound temporarily with some sealing gel.
They must have thought I was human, or they wouldn't have attacked me with this method.
You're lucky you're a Doll.
Stay where you are. Erwin and I are coming to get you.
Acknowledged... But this doesn't seem like a nice place at all.
AN-94 turns on her flashlight. The illuminated scene confirms what her other senses have suggested.

The bottom of the manhole is covered by a layer of countless white bones. On the top of the pile are two little skeletons garbed in uniforms of the orphanage. Their hollow gaze seems to bore right into her.
